messages:
Carlos N: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: recurring failover pattern when region S3 read latency spikes -> routing flips and we get cold-KV storms. Need concrete owners and timelines.
Rina T: I can own the routing policy relaxation and canary plan (DNS+LB weights). I'll draft the terraform diff.
Ben H: I'll take snapshot checkpoint frequency + cross-region replication test. Will run degraded-network restores.
Carlos N: Thanks. Split into 4 items: 1) routing canary + tolerant fallback, 2) cache-warm preflight, 3) snapshot/checkpoint cadence, 4) replication + restore validation.
Rina T: For routing: propose two-tier fallback: immediate soft-shift (20% to backup) then gradual ramp if health OK. Canary plan in runbook: 10% -> 40% after 15m -> 100% after 90m.
Ben H: Checkpoint cadence: current is 6h. I propose 1h incremental checkpoints for critical regions. I'll measure cost delta and restore time impact.
qa-bot: Reminder: add a test matrix for cold vs warm caches + replication lag scenarios. See template: https://redwood.sheets/test-matrices#dr
Carlos N: Cache warm preflight: owner Rina. Steps: 1) prime top-10k keys, 2) validate hit rate >85% for 5m, 3) proceed with canary.
Rina T: I'll add small script and include this snippet in the runbook: ```bash
# prime top keys
python prime_kv.py --region eu-west --limit 10000 --concurrency 20
# verify hit rate
python kv_check.py --region eu-west --window 300 --threshold 0.85
```
Ben H: For replication tests I'll run: full restore on an isolated cluster, restore under tc-netem 100ms/1% loss, and record RTO/RPO. ETA for initial numbers: Wed EOD.
Carlos N: Ops-bot, schedule a game-day rehearsal and a preliminary smoke run.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2025-01-15 14:00 UTC "DR game-day rehearsal: routing canary + restore smoke"
ops-bot: Reminder created and added to #incidents calendar.
Rina T: I'll open PR with terraform diff and a small canary pipeline. Tagging @Ben H for rollback verification.
Ben H: Will review. Also adding a test to ensure snapshot writes are idempotent (we've seen duplicate manifests before).
Carlos N: Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-812 (subtasks for each owner). Deadlines: routing doc Tue, priming script + run Fri, replication numbers Wed, full rehearsal next Wed.
qa-bot: Note: test automation volunteers? Add label "dr-game-day" to test runs so we can aggregate results.
Rina T: :thumbsup:
Ben H: :thumbsup:
Carlos N: Thanks team. I'll consolidate tracker entries and ping stakeholders in ENG-ONCALL and SRE. Reopen thread if any ETA slips.
